hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const hook='workflow-stage-guard.js';let dir=process.cwd();for(;;){const candidate=path.join(dir,'scripts','hooks',hook);if(fs.existsSync(candidate)&&fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,'.workflow'))){process.chdir(dir);require(candidate);break}const parent=path.dirname(dir);if(parent===dir){console.error('Stage-gated workflow hook not found from '+process.cwd());process.exit(1)}dir=parent}"
